name: Load all chat messages
description:
1. Reviewed `src/store/chats.js`: reload detection failed because a chat's status tracked "record fetched" but not "full messages loaded", so list/search summaries (last message only) were treated as complete.
2. First fix added a `needsReload` map and `registerChatSummary` helper, flagging summary chats so `loadChat`/`loadUninitialized` fetch full history before display.
3. The user noted that list/search results for already-loaded chats should refresh chat info but preserve existing full messages.
4. Second fix updated `registerChatSummary` to merge summary metadata while keeping `messages` when status is `LOADED`, skip when `LOADING`, and flag needs-reload otherwise.
5. Also set `ENTITY_STATUS.LOADED` in `findProjectChat` and reset flags on `clearChats`/`deleteChat`; noted the duplicate `createNewThread` action as remaining cleanup.

messages.content:
Review  chats store, the logic to detect when a chat needs to be reloaded is not working.
When chat is loaded with list or search it contains only the last message, so we must flag so when the chat is loaded to show to the user we'll reload to get all messages.

Review
Is it possible that we search/list a chat that was already loaded, we must keep their messages and just update other chat info.

history.summary:
- User reported that the chats store failed to detect when a chat needed reloading; list/search results contain only the last message. 
- Root cause: `ENTITY_STATUS.LOADED` conflated "record fetched" with "full history loaded", so summaries were treated as complete. 
- I introduced a `needsReload` flag plus a `registerChatSummary` helper to mark chats from list/recent/search sources. 
- Updated `loadChat`, `loadUninitialized`, `reloadChat`, `clearChats`, and `deleteChat` to respect and clear the flag. 
- Also noted secondary issues: duplicate `createNewThread` action, and search no longer clobbering full histories.
